open_points.subject: M19 Run.status / WaitingPoints
open_points.text: "While some nodes wait, independent branches keep running (K-09)." and "waiting: WaitingPoints (M20) while the run waits; ... its status is `awaiting_approval` when any of them waits for the owner's approval, otherwise `pending`;"
open_points.question: When a run has at least one waiting node but still has other runnable nodes, what single `status` must be stored: `running`, a waiting status, or does status switch only when no node can progress?
options: Set `status` to `awaiting_approval`/`pending` as soon as any waiting point exists, even if other branches are still running.
Keep `status`=`running` while any node can still execute; move to waiting status only when execution is otherwise blocked.
Allow both concepts separately (progress state + wait summary), not one exclusive status field.
open_points.default_guess: Use waiting precedence (`awaiting_approval` else `pending`) whenever any waiting point exists.

open_points.subject: M24 EffectApproval linkage to attempts
open_points.text: M24 candidate fields include "`run_id`, `node_id`, `map_index`, `binding_id`" but no `attempt_number`, while M26 requires "a resend after `not_applied` ... records the fresh approval it needed."
open_points.question: How is an approval request uniquely tied to a specific operation attempt when the same node/map can request approval multiple times across retries/resends?
options: Add `attempt_number` to EffectApproval and enforce one approval request per attempt.
Keep current fields and allow multiple approvals for the same node/map, selecting by latest requested record.
Enforce at most one non-final approval per node/map and reuse/replace it across attempts.
open_points.default_guess: Create a new approval per resend and link usage by approval_id from EffectAttempt, selecting the newest pending/approved record for that node/map.

open_points.subject: StandingGrant applied after a node is already waiting for owner approval
open_points.text: K-08 says a node stops for approval "unless the owner granted that exact flow version a standing approval for that node"; M25 says grants can be created/revoked, but no rule states what happens to an already-created M24 request and waiting point when a grant is added.
open_points.question: If a run is already `awaiting_approval` at a node and the owner grants a standing grant for that node/version, does the run continue under the grant immediately, and what status should the existing approval record take?
options: Immediately unblock and send under the new grant; leave existing approval record unchanged (`requested`) but no longer used.
Immediately unblock and mark the existing approval as superseded/cancelled (new status needed).
Do not affect existing waits; grant applies only to future reaches of that node.
open_points.default_guess: Unblock immediately under the grant and keep existing request record unused/unmodified.
